calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset signal that favors recent 20-session underperformers when their short volatility is compressed relative to their own 60-session volatility. Higher compression-scaled reversal values indicate expected positive forward returns; the validated artifact uses this sign convention. Inputs are observable through the prior completed session at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Passed the benchmark absolute daily paper IC and absolute daily paper ICIR gates on the full 15-instrument cross-asset universe. The negative sign is part of the validated orientation and must be respected by downstream factor direction handling. Long-horizon result is statistically stronger than 5D/10D diagnostics, but sign and small-universe uncertainty require monitoring.
